question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution:
The correct answer is "**Willfull**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, the word in option 2 is incorrectly spelled.
 
• The correct spelling is** "Willful"** with only one** "L"**.
 
• **"Willful"** means intentional or deliberate.(खुदराय)
 
 
• **Example**: *He was being **willful**__ by refusing to apologize.*
 
 
 
• The other words in the other options have correct spellings.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "Powerful",** is spelled correctly and means having great strength or influence.(ताकतवर)
 
• **Option 3, "Grateful",** is spelled correctly and means feeling or showing appreciation.(आभारी)
 
• **Option 4, "Doubtful",** is spelled correctly and means uncertain or unsure.(संदिग्ध)
